---
title: "Course Information Sheet (Laboratory)"
---

```{r}
#| label: lab-course-header-info
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "_data_helpers.R"))

# NOTE: this reads the same "course_info" schema sheet used by the theory
# course information sheet (08_course_information.qmd). When this template is
# used for a standalone laboratory course, point coursefile.schema.sheets in
# _quarto.yml at that course's own Course Information sheet.
render_course_header(cf_sheet("course_info"), cf_range("course_header"))
```
